g.text: BOUNDARIES County polygons are current statistical/cartographic context. Population ≠ household ≠ housing unit ≠ worker ≠ job ≠ commuter. Commuting ≠ migration; climate migration is a high-uncertainty scenario mechanism, not a population-growth assumption. No individual movement, utility-territory assignment, vulnerability/EJ score, or protected-class
